description: PosteAhora — social media on autopilot Staying consistent across every network is a grind: writing captions, switching apps, posting the same thing over and over. PosteAhora is built for how people work now — **connect an AI agent and let it run your posting for you.** A hosted **MCP server** and full **API** let **Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor** and other agents draft, schedule and publish from chat — 14 tools, no coding. Prefer hands-on? Do it yourself in one workspace: - **Cross-post to 9 networks*
